questions.prompt: When should the input stack be transferred to the output stack?

choices.label: Before every pop, even if the output stack has values.
choices.feedback: Transferring onto a nonempty output stack would place newer values ahead of older queued values.

choices.label: Only when the output stack is empty.
choices.feedback: Transferring onto a nonempty output stack would place newer values ahead of older queued values.

choices.label: Whenever either stack contains one value.
choices.feedback: Transferring onto a nonempty output stack would place newer values ahead of older queued values.

questions.prompt: Which stack should provide the next queued value?

choices.label: The stack with the larger size.
choices.feedback: The transfer reverses input order so the oldest queued value is at the output top.

choices.label: The input stack whenever it is nonempty.
choices.feedback: The transfer reverses input order so the oldest queued value is at the output top.

choices.label: The output stack after any needed transfer.
choices.feedback: The transfer reverses input order so the oldest queued value is at the output top.
